name: gnojs-interop-fixture
description: Signs the interop fixture with the official gno JS SDK. The two SDK versions are pinned, but their own dependencies are not and no lockfile is committed, so a regenerated fixture can differ from the committed one without either SDK being bumped. The fixture is a frozen wire sample for a Go test that needs no toolchain; live drift against the versions this repository builds with is what make test-e2e detects, by paying a real node with a real client.
